verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser's own Visalaw AI pages say what the AI automates: drafting petition letters and briefs, reviewing RFEs for deadlines, building exhibit lists, and extracting document data. They also state a data posture (SOC 2 Type II, no data retention). However, this is marketing for a product sold to other immigration teams, not a disclosure of how the firm uses AI on its own client petitions, and nothing says what a human attorney reviews. missing for 10: an explicit statement of the firm's own AI use in client petition work, a description of where attorney review applies versus what is automated, and any independent corroboration.
